title: New York bakery staff push for union, claiming they were forced to bake for Israeli fundraisers
summary: Breads Bakery workers demand better pay and conditions and criticize chain for supporting ‘the genocide in Palestine’Workers at popularNew YorkCity bakery chain Breads Bakery announced a move to unionize, claiming it has “underpaid, undervalued, disrespected, discriminated against, intimidated and hurt” staff, as well as supported “the genocide happening in Palestine”.The company, which has ties toIsrael, expressed concern that “divisive political issues” had been introduced into its stores. “We make babka; we don’t engage in politics,” a spokesperson said.Continue reading...
